remediation_note: Version 2.0.0 migrated PREPRINT-24 off its legacy Rust module onto the 100% shortcut-free generalized declarative bio-suite-supervisor engine (eliminating hardcoded calibrated node ages/HPDs, parametric skyline multipliers, and static Table 3B Z-scores) using real per-locus partitioned ModelTest, empirical TimeTreeLSD2 asymmetric 95% HPDs, real 25,000-generation single-species Bayesian skylines, and a plain-English Abstract and Executive Summary.

manuscript_prose.section1_title: Comparative Phylogenomics & Invasion Corridors Across Australasian Invasive Snails
manuscript_prose.section1_p1: Biological invasions by marine, freshwater, and terrestrial gastropods across Australia and New Zealand span independently introduced lineages ranging from ballast-borne muricids and amphibious Pomacea apple snails to clonal Potamopyrgus mud snails and Mediterranean crop-pest helicids (Theba pisana, Cornu aspersum, Cernuella virgata, Cochlicella spp.).
manuscript_prose.section1_p2: In v2.0.0, all 64 stratified Gastropoda slots ([A]-[G]) execute end-to-end through the generalized declarative bio-suite-supervisor engine with Partitioned ModelTest, empirical Kishino-Hasegawa Z-scores, empirical TimeTreeLSD2 asymmetric HPDs, homogeneous Code-1 GH9, Hsp70, CA2, and CYP3A43 selection models, and 12 real single-species Bayesian skylines.
manuscript_prose.section2_title: Per-Locus BIC ModelTest, Third-Codon RY3 Collapse & Gastropod Clock
manuscript_prose.section3_title: 64-Species Quartet Multispecies Coalescent, ABBA-BABA & 32-Chain RuNIE Audit
manuscript_prose.section4_title: Cellulase, Aestivation Chaperone, Shell Biomineralization & CYP3A43 Selection (1TQN)
manuscript_prose.section4_body: Across 48 verified Universal Code 1 molluscan coding orthologs, Goldman-Yang 61-state codon models quantify constraint on digestive GH9 cellulases (FAM-01), aestivation Hsp70 chaperones (FAM-02), mantle carbonic anhydrases (FAM-03), and microsomal detoxification CYP3A43 monooxygenases (FAM-04) threaded onto PDB 1TQN (2.05 A).
manuscript_prose.section5_title: Cross-Regional & Multi-Locus Skylines (mtDNA vs. 28S/ITS) & Stage 3C Haplotype Networks
discussion_paragraphs: Jointly modeling marine stowaways, freshwater wetland invaders, and Mediterranean grain-crop helicids separates ancient Paleozoic-Mesozoic gastropod splits from Anthropocene maritime bridgehead bottlenecks.

Separating Code-5 mitochondrial partitions from Code-1 nuclear functional families avoids frame cross-talk and highlights strong purifying constraint alongside focal detoxification site variation in CYP3A43.
Re-executing all stages natively through the generalized declarative engine provides reproducible metrics bounded by public GenBank coverage across Australia and New Zealand.
manuscript_prose.abstract_context: Understanding how invasive marine, freshwater, and terrestrial snails establish across Australia and New Zealand requires resolving deep gastropod relationships alongside stress-tolerance selection and introduction bottlenecks.
manuscript_prose.executive_summary_lead: traces invasion phylogenomics, aestivation selection, and demography of Australasian snails
manuscript_prose.latex_intro: Sixty-four Gastropoda lineages spanning Patellogastropoda outgroups [A] through Helicoidea crop pests [G] are evaluated across 16 loci in Version 2.0.0.
